possession.method: sum of possession-sequence duration (penalty shootout excluded)

story.text: France beat England 2-1 in the Quarter-finals of the FIFA World Cup 2022. England had more of the ball (60 percent to 40 percent), and England also created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (2.51 to 0.94). The goals came from Aurélien Tchouaméni at 16:22, Harry Kane at 53:27 (penalty) and Olivier Giroud at 77:10.
